whenToUse: Passing a link to people in the same place, such as a meetup or event.

Addresses that are long to type.
whenNotToUse: Sending to people far away (use a share sheet).
Addresses longer than 42 bytes (use a library or shorten the address).
Showing only the code and hiding the address.
